body:
Our church has been a fixture in the Flat Gap community since 1909 when it was organized and admitted into the Enterprise Baptist Association of Regular Baptists.  Reverend R.H. Hayes served as the church's first pastor.

Our current church building was built in 1979 and bricked in 1992.

We have happily been an Independent Baptist Church since 1985 when we voted to voluntarily withdraw from the Enterprise Association.  We continue, however, to have rich fellowship with our brothers and sisters in Christ who serve the Lord in many other churches.

During the past 6 decades the church has had only 3 pastors:  Brothers Harold Salyer, Johnny Estep, and Robert Blanton.  Brother Harold was pastor for 28 years, Brother Johnny for 16 years, and Brother Robert for 16 years!

Brother Harold became our pastor in 1964 and served through most of 1991 when his employment moved him away.  Since his retirement we have been blessed he was able to return to us and are very thankful he continues to serve God here at his home church!

Brother Johnny was pastor from 1992 - 2008 and Brother Robert from 2009 - 2025.  Brother Eric Lauterwasser is our current pastor.

Our church has been blessed throughout our 128 year history and greatly used by God, as evidenced by the many souls saved, the multitude of folks who have grown closer to the Lord, and the members of the community who have been helped.

We look forward to seeing how God will continue to use our church as we follow our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ!

Come on and join us at Flat Gap Baptist in this grand and glorious journey!
